title: (3) case-reply disarm + unexpected pre-ADV reset under openCFW early arm
scope: Emulator-only. Same opencfw-otap-disarm image. No rebuild required. No hardware flash. No commit.

case_reply_disarm.method: Boot past ADV disarm (OTAP→0), re-arm OTAPOINTER=0xAFD1363A via MMIO so case-reply is the disarm under test, inject proven pogo product-test frame on uart2.
case_reply_disarm.frame_note: Prior wrong candidate 01 00 00 00 00 84 did not disarm. boot-trace STATUS 2026-11-02 recipe used.
case_reply_disarm.post_reset: g2.reset SBL application handoff VTOR=0x00438000 SP=0x2007FB00 PC=0x0059427D
case_reply_disarm.result: PASS — DEV_BoxRevcMsgProcess reply path calls g2_recovery_disarm_healthy; OTAP cleared; intentional reset hands off to app.

unexpected_reset_before_advertising.method: Arm at 0.01s (OTAP=0xAFD1363A, host packets 0), then machine Reset before ADV.
unexpected_reset_before_advertising.post_reset: g2.reset SBL wired-load (OTAPOINTER=0xAFD1363A); application not entered
unexpected_reset_before_advertising.result: PASS as designed — unexpected/watchdog-class reset while still armed lands in SBL wired-load (same signature as app-dead). Recovery requires a host on the pogo/SBL wired-load path.

remaining_risk.pogo_sbl_reachability_on_silicon: UNPROVEN — Renode g2.reset models wired-load vs handoff from OTAPOINTER, but real Ambiq SBL UART/pogo programming and probe-bridge HELLO are not exercised here.
remaining_risk.app_dead_without_host: If the temple hangs after early arm and before ADV/case disarm, next reset correctly enters SBL wired-load; without a wired host the temple still looks brick-dead (no BLE).
remaining_risk.both_dev_temples_already_bricked: Pre-arm builds; cannot be armed retroactively. Do not flash the primary pair.
remaining_risk.crash_loop_gate_unwired: Still needs a hardware reset-signature before it can replace unconditional early arm.
remaining_risk.sim_hw_gap: Hang that bricks hardware still not reproduced in Renode; recovery experiment is the iteration enabler, not a closed root-cause.

next.rationale: NVM/FD01/FD07/FC4E, mismatch DFU through INFO commit, intentional-reset disarm, ADV disarm, case-reply disarm, and pre-ADV unexpected-reset→wired-load are all covered in Renode. Further progress needs silicon feedback (does early arm stick? does SBL accept probe-bridge? does Fix 51/ADC move the hang?).
next.hardware_test_plan_doc: g2/docs/hardware-test-plan.md section 2026-11-22 case-reply + early-reset + sacrificial-temple plan
